fit: acute ginger capsules and upper gastrointestinal physiology
assessment: The healthy liquid-meal crossover measured faster emptying and no difference in reported gastrointestinal symptoms. It supplied no constipation, colonic-transit or Parkinson outcome.

fit: Parkinson gastric MRI comparing two medicines
assessment: DA-9701 met the active-comparator gastric-emptying noninferiority margin. Neither arm tests ginger. The registered separate constipation diary outcome is unavailable from the inspected abstract and registry.
Five of 47 safety completers reported diarrhea. The open design gives no attributable rate or constipation comparison. The thesis repeats these events within the same research program.

fit: powdered ginger and indirect upper gastrointestinal physiology
assessment: The 16-person healthy placebo comparison found an inconclusive difference in paracetamol time to peak. Its proxy and preparation differ from the frozen claim, and it did not measure constipation.

fit: acute capsules and symptoms in healthy adults
assessment: The 24-person crossover measured faster liquid-meal emptying without a clear difference in gastrointestinal ratings. It did not supply a Parkinson pain comparison.

fit: ginger capsules and epigastric pain reporting in functional dyspepsia
assessment: Among 51 completers, epigastric pain reports fell from 34 to 19 over four weeks without a comparator. This is a frequency measurement with incomplete attrition data, and it differs from grated ginger and Parkinson pain. Subsequent cohort outputs are linked in the packet.

fit: ginger powder and indirect gastric comparison in healthy adults
assessment: The placebo comparison reported an inconclusive gastric proxy difference at 1 g. It complicates a consistent motility explanation while supplying no pain estimate.

fit: ginger capsules and dyspepsia quality-of-life subitem
assessment: The 51 completers improved on overall dyspepsia quality of life. The separate tension item was inconclusive at p=.670. The report does not supply a Parkinson anxiety endpoint or the registered EQ-5D item results.
